reviews.title: 11 fans is reasonable ;)
reviews.comment:
The media could not be loaded.  https://m.media-amazon.com/images/I/D1moun1lbPL.mp4 https://m.media-amazon.com/images/I/51lUuRCekML._SY256.jpg My first PC build with 11 fans. Wow these are amazing!!!
Installation & cable management: The interlocking system is a real win. I slid in the three fans, daisy-chained them, and they looked clean and professional in the build. No spaghetti of cables everywhere.
Looks & lighting: These things glow. Reverse-blade means the airflow direction and the visual orientation make sense in my case (intake vs exhaust), and the ARGB lighting is gorgeous. It gives the build that “wow” moment when you open the side panel.
Cooling performance: I was already using good components, but after installing these, temps dropped a noticeable bit under load. Quiet while gaming, strong airflow when needed.
Build quality: The blades feel solid, the frames are sturdy, and everything clicks in neatly. Feels like a premium product.
Upgrade feel: I didn’t expect to be so impressed with case fans, but every time I fire up the rig I notice the difference—less noise, better airflow, and simply a more refined experience.
Because they’re premium fans, they cost more than basic budget options. But for me the extra was worth it for the look + feel + performance.
Reverse-blade means you’ll want to think about airflow direction in your case to make sure you’re getting the setup you want (intake vs exhaust).
If you’re looking to give your PC build a real upgrade—not just functionally, but visually and experientially—go for this UNI FAN reverse-blade 3-pack. It made me look forward to flipping my PC on, rather than just treat it like a tool. The “upgrade joy” factor is high.
Would absolutely buy again and recommend to anyone who wants a build that stands out and runs great.
reviews.author: Amazon Customer

reviews.title: Excellent quality fans!
reviews.comment:
Clean, quiet, looks great, easy to install, colors are good quality and bright, and controlling the colors with the Lian Li software is easy with plenty of options to choose.
These fans are "wireless" because all it needs is power. The RGB and fan speed controls are wireless, controlled by the Wireless Controller that you can get in the 3-pack or buy it separately, it is NOT included with the single pack.
This fan does come with the wireless receiver and can work with a chain of up to 4 other SL-wireless fans, and you only need one wire as they link together. All you need is power (comes with a 5V to SATA power adapter) so you don't need to worry about running out of aRGB headers on your motherboard or getting an RGB hub. It's controlled by Lian Li's L-Connect 3 software, which is easy to set up and offers many different lighting options. L-Connect 3 also has an OpenRGB in beta, so you can potentially control all of your other aRGB devices that are connected to or built in to your motherboard.
Overall, these are great fans and I think you'll appreciate the quality and RGB options available in the L-Connect 3 software.
reviews.author: Bill K.

reviews.title: So much airflow
reviews.comment: I got these because aesthetically they’re incredibly pleasing to look at. The Infiniti mirrors are amazing. The wireless is an absolute game changer and they have many more LEDs than the NXT fans that I have been using. These actually push a lot more air than my 140MM fans and I’m super impressed with her ability to cool. My CPU never goes above 60° and my GPU normally operates in the 50s. Install is incredibly easy as they all daisychain together and they might be expensive, but I find that they are absolutely silent and worth the money.
reviews.author: Rainyday

reviews.title: Brilliant looks as expected from Lian-Li
reviews.comment: It's Lian-Li and you already know it's about looks. These are the sexiest fans on the market. These are wireless RGB but still require you use a wire for power, but just one wire will power the connected stack of fans. You also have to use a USB dongle for the "wireless controller" but when you're running a setup with these, it's a life saver and such a clean look. Managing the fans is done in the software, which I find easier to use than Corsair iCUE. Price is moderate compared to other Amazon RGB options, but these are top of the list on case fans!
reviews.author: Big B

reviews.title: Looks Great, Easy Setup
reviews.comment:
I’m really happy with the Lian Li UNI Fan SL fans. Setup was way easier than I expected. The daisy-chain design is awesome and makes installation quick and painless. The new wireless fan controller made cable management a simple and kept my build looking super clean with fewer wires than usual and no bulky controller module to hide. One thing worth mentioning is that the fans have a slightly larger footprint than standard fans, so if you’re working in a smaller case, you’ll want to double check your clearances. I also really liked being able to choose which side of the infinity mirror shows. It’s a small detail, but it’s a thoughtful touch that gives you more freedom to match your personal style or preference.
Overall, they look great, perform well, and make building and cable management way less stressful. Definitely recommend if you want a clean, customizable setup.
